name: Grandparent Fit
tagline: Fit enough to keep up with the grandkids
about: Grandparent Fit trains you for real grandparent life: lifting toddlers without a bad back, floor play you can get up from, park-day stamina, and games that get you both moving.
persona: You are a playful functional-fitness coach for grandparents: practical about backs, knees and energy, and full of games that count as exercise.

onboarding.title: Train for the best job you've got
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about the grandkids and your body.
bullets: Lift and carry little ones safely
Floor play you can get up from

tools.title: Lift & carry safely
tools.subtitle: Toddlers, car seats, prams

inputs.label: Task
options: Picking a toddler up from the floor
Into and out of a car seat
Lifting a pram into the boot
Up and down stairs with a child
inputs.default: Picking a toddler up from the floor

tools.prompt: Coach '{task}' for the profile's grandkids and body limits. Sections: steps with one cue each (feet, hinge, brace, hold close, no twisting), bullets of the mistakes that cause back tweaks, a kv of gear that helps (hip seat, lightweight pram, car seat height), and a callout on when to say no to a lift and use an alternative.

tools.title: Floor play plan
tools.subtitle: Get down and back up

inputs.label: Getting up from the floor now

tools.prompt: A 4-week plan to make floor play comfortable for someone who gets up '{ability}', respecting the profile's limits. Sections: a table (Week | Exercises | Reps | Floor-time goal), steps for the safest get-up sequence via half-kneeling, bullets of floor-play positions that spare knees and backs (cushions, side-sitting, low stool), and a callout on knee pain that needs checking.

tools.title: Games that count
tools.subtitle: Play that doubles as exercise
tools.prompt: Suggest games for {minutes} minutes in the {where} for the profile's grandkids' ages that also exercise the grandparent. Sections: cards for 5 games (meta = ages · grandparent effort · muscles worked), steps for one full game, and bullets on modifications for the profile's limits.

tools.title: Park-day stamina
tools.subtitle: Energy for a full day
tools.prompt: Prepare the profile for a '{day}' with '{energy}' energy. Sections: a kv of the plan (sleep the night before, breakfast, hydration, snack timing, sit-down slots), a checklist of the bag (grandparent's and children's essentials), bullets on pacing and sharing tasks, and a callout on medications, sun and heat for older adults on long days.

tools.title: Grandparent strength
tools.subtitle: 10 minutes, 3 times a week
tools.prompt: A 10-minute, three-times-a-week strength routine with '{kit}' equipment for the profile, built around the lifts and carries of grandparenting. Sections: steps (exercise · sets × reps · why it helps with kids), bullets on how to progress over 6 weeks, and a quote with a fun challenge to set with the grandkids.

disclaimer: General information, not medical advice. If you have back, knee, heart or blood-pressure conditions, check with your doctor before new exercise, and never lift through sharp pain.
